Known gap: patch 52, g-band

15 quanta (0.4%) were never executed: detection on patch 52/g-band hit ZeroFootprintError — genuinely zero detectable sources in that region (0.37% good pixels under this deliberately sparse "central six" visit selection), a physical data floor rather than a relaxable QA threshold. 11 task types that depended solely on that quantum are absent for that patch; the tract-wide consolidation tasks (computeObjectEpochs, transformObjectTable, etc.) proceeded without its contribution. Full recovery sequence, including three QA thresholds that were successfully relaxed for two other sparse patches, is in qgraph_manifest.json → provenance.timing_run.
